summary.business_type: Local brick-and-mortar restaurant (Italian-leaning cafe & bar, Woodbridge/Vaughan ON) with sister bakery on a separate domain
top_findings: Homepage title/H1 never say 'restaurant', 'Vaughan' or 'Italian'; ~4,600 impressions at pos 4.9 convert at 2.8% (rewrite recommended 2026-09-19, not shipped)
Fragmented entity: two Google place IDs, two Instagram handles, wrong Apple Maps/Yelp data, 'Penelope Focacceria' alias
No page or positioning owns 'Italian restaurant Vaughan' (982 impr, pos 19.6)
/catering-events thin (~190 words); Christmas packages only in a popup during booking season
No security headers and no long-lived caching for hashed assets
quick_wins: Unmark popup_view, popup_dismiss, nav_menu_click, faq_open, announcement_dismiss as GA4 key events (~80% of organic 'conversions')
Fix sameAs Instagram handle and strip tracking params (web/src/data/site.ts:44-45)
aria-labels on the catering form select/textarea
Add web/public/_headers for security headers + immutable /_astro caching

findings.title: No security headers
findings.description: No HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, X-Frame-Options/CSP; web/public has no _headers file.

findings.title: /locations/scarborough not indexed
findings.description: GSC: Discovered - currently not indexed, never crawled, yet in sitemap.
findings.recommendation: noindex + remove from sitemap; keep as sister card linking to penelopebakehouse.com.

findings.title: GA4 key events inflated by engagement events
findings.description: popup_view, popup_dismiss, nav_menu_click, faq_open, announcement_dismiss marked as key events: 3,856 of 4,786 organic key events.
findings.recommendation: Unmark them in GA4 Admin > Events; keep reservation/order/catering/call/directions/lead/gift/merch.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Four Vaughan landing pages are substantive (535-660 unique words, prices, FAQs) and do not cannibalize

findings.title: No brunch or happy-hour content
findings.description: Both words appear 0 times; brunch 704 impr @ 9.6; 'penelope social happy hour' ~25% CTR.
findings.recommendation: Client decision; build pages if offers exist, else honest FAQ/sections.

findings.title: /catering-events thin
findings.description: ~190 words main copy; no capacity, packages, pricing, photos; Christmas packages only in popup; 24h vs 72h notice conflict.
findings.recommendation: Expand with capacity, per-person table, December packages, photos, consistent notice.

findings.title: Bakehouse anchors point internally
findings.description: Home/cafe/pizza/about link 'Bakehouse' to /locations/scarborough; its FAQs speak as the Bakehouse.

findings.title: Repeated starter story
findings.description: Near-verbatim on three landing pages and twice on /about.
findings.recommendation: Replace with page-specific first-hand detail and review quotes.

findings.title: Weak authority signals
findings.description: No press, no quoted reviews, no opening year.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Unique titles and metas on every page

findings.title: Homepage title/H1 mis-targeted
findings.description: 'Penelope Social | Cafe and bar in Woodbridge'; 'restaurant' 0 times on page; restaurants-in-Vaughan CTR 2.8% at pos 4.9.
findings.recommendation: Title 'Penelope Social | Italian Restaurant & Bar in Vaughan'; H1 'Italian restaurant, cafe and bar in Woodbridge, Vaughan'.

findings.title: /catering-events title
findings.recommendation: 'Catering & Private Events in Vaughan | Penelope Social'.

findings.title: Duplicate merch H1s
findings.description: Hoodie, t-shirt, tote all H1 'Merch'; titles 23-26 chars.

findings.title: Long titles/metas
findings.description: Lunch 71, dinner 67, catering menu 62 chars; tote meta 305, catering menu meta 201.

findings.title: No <main> landmark
findings.description: 16 of 20 pages lack <main>; no header/footer elements.

findings.title: Dangling supplier @id
findings.description: supplier -> penelopebakehouse.com/#bakery not defined on merch pages (schema.ts:90).
findings.recommendation: Always include bakehouseSchema() or drop supplier.

findings.title: Favicon as image; no WebSite node
findings.recommendation: Real photos + logo; WebSite node on /.

findings.title: sameAs thin and inconsistent
findings.description: Instagram handle differs from site links; tracking params; no GBP/Yelp.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Field CWV all good: LCP 485ms, INP 62ms, CLS 0, TTFB 134ms

findings.title: Turnstile sitewide
findings.description: ~600-700KB challenge payload on homepage; likely driver of 10s mobile lab LCP (hypothesis).
findings.recommendation: Lazy explicit render only on form pages.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Search/retrieval bots allowed (OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Claude-SearchBot, Googlebot)

findings.title: Not cited for Italian/brunch prompts
findings.description: Absent from top 20 (Brave) for 'best Italian restaurant Vaughan', 'brunch Vaughan'.

findings.title: AI training bots blocked vs robots.txt Allow
findings.description: GPTBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot 403; also explains absence from Common Crawl.
findings.recommendation: Decide policy in Cloudflare AI Crawl Control and make robots.txt match.

findings.title: llms.txt fails Lighthouse; internal notes
findings.description: Plain 'Label: URL' lines, no summary, ops notes, missing landing pages.
